crossRefs.note: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: David said to the young man who told him, “How do you know that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?”
translations.bsb: Then David asked the young man who had brought him the report, “How do you know that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?”
translations.kjv: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son be dead?
translations.asv: And David said unto the young man that told him, How knowest thou that Saul and Jonathan his son are dead?
